content.title:
Last digit of any power,
*in 10 seconds.*
content.legend: last digits repeat every 4 powers: divide n by 4 and use the remainder (take 4 if it is 0)

caption:
Last digit of any power in 10 seconds ✍️

7²³: the cycle is 7, 9, 3, 1, and 23 ÷ 4 leaves 3, so it ends in 3.

Your turn: last digit of 3²⁰²⁶? Comment below 👇
